courses.note: Two public syllabi from different instructors with different outcomes: the Fall 2025 sections 001/002 syllabus (recorded) prohibits GenAI and lists any use of GenAI in a homework solution as cheating; a Spring 2026 section 003 syllabus (https://ranger.uta.edu/~weems/NOTES3318/syllabusSpr26.pdf, text saved at .cache/text/v2c-texas-arlington-C3-pdf.txt) has no AI mention, only a cheating-policy pointer to university community standards. It is not listed under syllabi because the validator requires ai_passages on every syllabus of a public-ai-policy course. The catalog title is Algorithms & Data Structures; the major requires no separate algorithms course.

courses.note: Elective, not required: the BS Computer Science lists CSE 4308 among technical electives (six of the list are chosen) and requires no AI or ML course. CSE 4308 is the introductory AI course and is taught every term by the same instructor, with public syllabi for Spring 2025, Summer 2025, Fall 2024, Spring 2026 and Summer 2026. The newest (Summer 2026, co-listed as CSE 5360) was read: it has no generative-AI statement; it says the programming assignment must be the student's own work and that violations go to the Office of Academic Integrity. Spring 2026 (https://crystal.uta.edu/~gopikrishnav/classes/2026/spring/4308_5360/4308_5360_Spr_2026.pdf) was not read.
